title: Pressure-driven Poiseuille channel (analytic)
description:
Steady laminar flow of a liquid between two no-slip walls (y faces), driven by a pressure dp on the inlet face x_lo against 0 on the outlet x_hi.
Analytic: u_x = (dp/L) y (H - y) / (2 mu), u_y = 0, p = dp (1 - x/L), flow rate per m of depth Q = dp H^3 / (12 mu L).
Line profile tab: u_profile (u_x across the channel at x = L/2, the parabola) and p_profile (pressure along the centreline, linear); both show the last sweep value, the base H_ch = 20 um.
Derived values tab: Q_sim against Q_ref (the cell-centre sum overshoots by (dx/H)^2/2 = 1.25e-3 at 20 cells), u_max against the parabola at the centre-most cell centre (1e-4 at 20 um, 1e-3 at 40 um: the pressure faces' error grows with the Reynolds number), p_mean against dp/2.
Sweep tab: Q_sim versus H_ch (10..40 um) with the dashed H^3 law Q_vs_H; per point ~5e-3 at 10 um down to ~3e-4 at 40 um (mostly the midpoint offset (dx/H)^2/2 above; pressure faces, float32).

parameters.name: mu_f
parameters.description: dynamic viscosity of the liquid in Pa s (water-like)

parameters.name: H_ch
parameters.description: channel height along y (even cell counts only: u_max_ref assumes the centreline is a cell edge); swept

parameters.name: dp
parameters.description: pressure drop in Pa (inlet gauge pressure, outlet 0); kept low (Re <= 0.13 at H = 40 um): the pressure faces' error grows with Re (u_max ~4e-3 off at dp = 8 Pa, H = 40 um)

parameters.name: Q_ref
parameters.description: analytic flow rate per m of depth in m^2/s

parameters.name: u_max_ref
parameters.description: parabola at the cell centres next to the centreline (dx/2 off it) in m/s (~1.25 mm/s at H = 20 um)
